title: Magic Princess Dress Up Doll
description: Welcome to Magic Princess Dress Up Doll, a casual dress-up game for girl gamers. Have you ever dreamed of becoming a beautiful princess one day? Are you an enthusiast of dressing up fashion dolls? Come join us and realize all your imaginations about fashion design! This is a fashion design game where you can make up your own doll from scratch.

title: Magic Piano Music
description: Ready to become a piano master? In Magic Piano Music, tap the magic tiles to follow the beats and play your favorite music. Follow the rhythm of the music and click with precision, don't miss any notes. The game will end after three misses. There's tons of music here like classic piano music, pop music and more! Every song will take you on an immersive arcade rhythm adventure.

title: Idle Bank
description: Idle Bank is not merely a management game but also a simulation game. With 3D stickman characters in a bank, you can control the manager to develop a bank. First, you can use the starting money to unlock a basic Reception to absorb customers. When people come into the bank and save their money here, you can take away them to unlock new facilities and hire assistants. Don't forget to upgrade your character for better capacity ability and higher speed.

title: Travel With Me: ASMR Edition
description: Prepare to jet-set across the world with Travel With Me: ASMR Edition! Join Lisa, the stylish vlogger, as she explores stunning destinations, allowing you to dress her up in fabulous outfits that match each location perfectly. From the serene temples of Thailand to the desert adventures in Dubai, and the tropical paradise of Maldives, challenge your fashion skills and create unforgettable looks for every occasion.

title: Obby Prison Run
description: Obby Prison Run is an intense obstacle course game where escape is the only option—and survival is everything. Sprint, leap, and dodge through deadly traps and twisted takes on classic childhood games. Outsmart your rivals and stay ahead in the race for freedom, where every second counts and only the sharpest make it out alive.

title: Avatar Life My Town
description: Avatar Life: My Town game is a casual simulator game for kids. You can enjoy creating your sweet home stories! Meet fun family characters in the dollhouse game! Role-play house games and manage family life in your new home! You need to take good care of your character and prepare delicious food. Cooking a big meal.

title: Colors pins
description:
Someone has pinned a lot of pins, and you need to put them all away in boxes, and most importantly, make sure that the colors match!

Game Features:

A variety of levels
Colorful graphics
Relaxing gameplay

title: Zombies Weapon Merge 4
description: Zombies are swarming. Are you ready to fight back? Zombies 4 – Weapon Merge is an exciting shooting and strategy game where every decision matters. Match and merge weapons to create powerful guns, then aim and shoot endless waves of zombies. Combine identical weapons, upgrade your firepower, and place them smartly to survive tougher enemies.

title: Fun Sorting Through The Shelves
description: Unwind with this charming match-3 puzzle game! Spot matching items, place them neatly on shelves, and merge triplets to free up space. Collect treasures, decorate, and design your own cozy virtual nook in a relaxing experience for all ages.

title: Italian Brainrot Bike Rush
description: Hop on for chaotic fun in Italian Brainrot Bike Rush, a meme-filled obby bike platformer. Pick from 5 absurd meme legends and ride through floating platforms, deadly traps, and wild jumps. Play 5 levels across 3 modes—Normal, Challenge, and One Life. Collect coins, unlock checkpoints, and conquer brainrot chaos. Perfect for fans of meme-based bike racing and Italian brainrot platformers!

title: Wood Color Block
description: Step into the colorful puzzle world of Wood Color Block, where strategy and quick thinking collide. Slide vibrant blocks into place, match them with their crushers, and clear the board before time runs out. With each level, the puzzles grow more challenging, pushing your skills to the limit.

title: Slippery Drift Racing
description: Slippery Drift Racing is an adrenaline-pumping racing game where precision and speed go hand in hand. Players can choose between Race and Time Attack modes, tackling five unique and challenging maps. With three difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, and Hard—drivers of all skill levels can enjoy sliding through tight corners, mastering drifts, and racing against the clock or opponents. Perfect for fans of high-speed thrills and skillful maneuvers, every race promises excitement and challenge!

title: Inspector Cat
description:
Inspector Cat is a competitive hidden object game where you play as a sharp-eyed cat inspector racing against other feline players!
Each round challenges you to find specific items on a crowded board full of objects. Be faster and more accurate than the other cats to earn points and climb the ranking.
Stay focused, react quickly, and prove you’re the best inspector in the pack!

title: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls
description: With Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls, users can unleash their creativity and design unique outfits for their dolls. The game offers a wide range of clothing options, accessories, and hairstyles to choose from, allowing players to mix and match to their heart's content.

title: Princess vs Shark
description:
Dive into a magical underwater world with “Princess vs Shark”!
Game Features:
	•	Engaging Gameplay: Solve puzzles, guide water flows, and help the princess overcome obstacles.
	•	Beautiful Graphics: Immerse yourself in the enchanting underwater world.
	•	Challenging Levels: Each level gets harder and more thrilling!
	•	Easy Controls: Simple and intuitive controls make it accessible for everyone.

title: Sneaker Art
description: Sneaker Art is a creative casual art game where you become a pro sneaker designer. Grab your paintbrush, unleash your imagination, and craft unique shoe designs. Choose from a variety of laces, showcase your artwork, and sell your masterpieces in your sneaker shop. Pack your custom sneakers in stylish boxes and grow your business with every sale!

title: Pew Pew Dose
description:
Build the weapon of your dreams and blast through hordes of cute… yet deadly zombie rascals!

Welcome to a bright and crazy post-apocalypse where only the most creative weapon makers survive. In this arcade 3D mayhem, you start with a simple gun… and end up wielding a monster built from multiple barrels twisted together into insane contraptions!

Craft without limits: attach barrel to barrel, add magazines, boost firepower, and create unique weapons that would make enemies run away…

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.

title: Scala 40
description:
Scala 40 is an Italian card game played with two French decks and jokers.

Players form sets and runs to reach at least 40 points and lay down their first combinations.

Each turn, players draw and discard, trying to optimize their hand and use their own or opponents’ combinations.

The first player to run out of cards wins, while the others add up the points of their remaining cards.

title: Nubik: Create Your Place
description:
Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

The game features many skins for Nubiks, achievements, a leaderboard, and chat.

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Color Sort: Impostor Edition
description: Color Sort Impostor Edition is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your logic and focus. Sort the colorful characters into the correct tubes so that each tube contains only one color. The rules are simple, but the puzzles quickly become more challenging as new colors and obstacles appear. Plan your moves carefully, avoid mistakes, and enjoy a smooth, satisfying sorting experience designed for players of all ages.

title: Hero Transform Run
description: Superheroes accumulate energy by constantly upgrading themselves, and at the end of the level they must quickly defeat different enemies. This is a casual combat parkour game!

title: Block Breaker
description: Embark on a 2D adventure filled with dynamic physics! Break ice blocks, use springs and portals, and launch the character through the air to reach the goal platform. Master the environment and discover all the creative ways to complete each level!"

title: Duck Luck
description:
Guide a lovable duck and his humorous friend and drop numbered blocks that merge when identical numbers come into contact, creating larger numbers that help clear the board. 
As you strategize and match numbers, you'll earn points. 
The goal is to accumulate the highest score possible by making as big of a number as you can.

title: Reflect Beam: Laser Logic
description:
Logic game where every move changes the beam’s path. 

5 modes - 5 types of challenges.
Tunnel: rotate shapes and guide the beam through narrow passages.
Labyrinth: draw a safe path to the exit.
Same Colors: remove blocks of the right color to open the route.
Obstacles: move elements and clear the way for the beam.
Time is limeted: solve faster and more accurately before time runs out.

title: Survival Island: EVO
description: Play a fun adventure and simulation game in Survival Island: EVO. You are alone on a mysterious island, and the challenge begins: survive, build, and thrive. Gather more resources like food, water, wood, and stone. And craft the tools you need to stay alive. Build your shelter, light a fire, and protect yourself from hunger and wild animals. Explore hidden corners of the island, discover secrets, and unlock new crafting recipes. Become the true survivor.

title: Neon Dash: Cyber Run
description:
Neon Dash: Cyber Run is a high-speed endless runner set in a glowing cyber world.
Jump over deadly spikes, pass through portals to shift themes, and survive as
the game speed increases over time.

The game is designed for short, replayable sessions with instant restarts.
Perfect for both desktop and mobile players.

title: Knots
description: Knots is a colorful HTML5 puzzle game for all ages! This is a simple logic puzzle where players move puzzle pieces to arrange the knot drawings correctly. Move hexagon tiles to connect matching knots and create beautiful patterns. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for kids and adults — with lots of bright levels and fun challenges for the whole family!

title: 1945 Air Force Space Shooter
description: Prepare for nonstop action in 1945 Air Force: Space Shooter! Inspired by the classic shooter era, this game combines vintage visuals with thrilling bulletstorm gameplay that will test your reflexes and precision.Fly through endless waves of enemy aircraft. Avoid storms of bullets and unleash devastating firepower from your Force fighter.

title: Crazy Bar Brawl
description: Crazy Bar Brawl ?? throws you straight into the most chaotic, hilarious, and action-packed bar battles ever! If you’ve ever wondered what would happen if you walked into a bar full of drunk troublemakers ?, flying bottles ?, wobbling chairs ?, and wild characters who can barely stand… well, now you can experience it ALL—safely, virtually, and with maximum comedy!

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!

title: Maido
description: Welcome to the Maido Shop! Pull items from the box and merge them together. The more you merge, the better the items become. Do you have what it takes to unlock the final item? Set the right price to sell your goods! If it's too cheap, you lose profit. If it's too expensive, you gain nothing. Start managing your shop now!

title: SUV Traffic Racer
description: In SUV Traffic Racer, you will be playing SUVs through stunning endless highways. Skim through the highway traffic and make the highest score by going as far as you can, Unlock more than 6 SUVs to make the ultimate SUV garage. Upgrade your SUV with 4 awesome upgrades and get the most out of those roaring engines. Enjoy the picturesque highways and conquer it with your driving skills. Are you ready to show if you're the finest highway racer out there?

title: Cyber Arrow
description: Play Cyber Arrow – a fast, fun online game where you become a Techno Archer! Fly a remote-controlled arrow, solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and rescue hostages across 3 exciting game modes in a stunning sci-fi world.

title: DuaLight - A Reflected Game
description:
DuaLight is a challenging 2D pixel art hyper-casual platformer. The true path lies in the reflection. 

Navigate levels where the real world tricks your eyes, and only those who watch the reflection below can move forward. Minimalist and short.

In DuaLight – A Reflected Game, nothing is as it seems… or rather, everything only appears in the reflection. You control a character in a world where invisible platforms can’t be seen in the real world, but only in the reflection below the screen.

title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description: Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy and fly through levels full of danger: fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control, but surviving takes focus and reflexes.

title: Men Vs Gorillas
description:
Men vs Gorilla – The Ultimate Evolution Battle!

Step into the wild showdown of Man vs Gorilla!
Upgrade your human’s strength, damage, and health to survive the rising fury of the jungle’s strongest beast. ?

Each level brings a tougher gorilla, smarter attacks, and intense battles but also bigger rewards!
Use your earnings to level up your power, evolve your fighter, and dominate every fight!

title: Dan the Man
description: With a cracking funny story, action, an awesome upgradeable fighting skills and an epic arsenal of weapons that will make even the most heroic of heroes envious, Dan The Man's arcade fight fest has enough enemies and boss fights to satisfy every hardcore Action Platformer enthusiast and every indie game lover.

title: Hexa Sort Trick or Treat
description: Step into a haunted puzzle realm where glowing hexagonal blocks hide within a web of spooky challenges. Your task: sort eerie, color-coded pieces into their rightful places before the shadows close in. With every drag and drop, you’ll sharpen your wits and unravel chillingly clever layouts that grow trickier as you progress. Easy to pick up yet devilishly addictive, this Halloween brain-teaser will keep players of all ages spellbound through hundreds of spooky levels.

title: Zoo Anomaly Simulation
description: Experience a zoo mutation crisis like no other. In Zoo Anomaly Simulation, a peaceful zoo has turned into a nightmare filled with mutated animals, and you’re the only one who can stop the chaos! Enter a first-person shooting experience like no other. Explore the eerie zoo environment, grab your weapons, and fight back against giraffes, zebras, elephants, etc.

title: Count Masters Superhero
description: In Count Masters: Superhero, begin an interesting parkour adventure like no other! As a superhero,you're constantly running, jumping, and avoiding obstacles throughout the level. Such as avoiding rotating mace, cutting machine and so on.

title: Love Colors
description: Dive into Love Colors, the ultimate relaxing coloring app! Transform this elegant Art Nouveau portrait of a graceful woman—adorned with swirling leaves and blooms—using lush reds, pinks, and light pinks. Effortless tools: zoom, undo, redo, and instant download. Unleash creativity, melt stress away!

title: Run from Baba Yaga
description:
Run from Baba Yaga is a potentially endless runner in which player has to collect as much treasures as possible and run as long as possible while Baba Yaga is trying to catch up with them.

During the chase, Baba Yaga gradually gets stronger: her movespeed and damage increase.An outstanding result can be achieved if player reaches the last stage of the game by running 400 hexes (hexagonal pieces of path).

title: Aidan in Danger
description: Aidan in Danger is an exciting platformer where you play as Aidan, a young red-haired elf armed with a slingshot. Your mission is to protect Drakor, the last dragon on Earth, from an interdimensional villain bent on world domination. Battle dangerous monsters, travel through time, and navigate challenging levels in this epic adventure. With immersive gameplay, stunning graphics, and a gripping story, help Aidan save Drakor and restore peace to the land!

title: 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle
description: We've taken the classic sliding puzzle into a whole new 3D world. Kids will need to slide the scrambled blocks to rearrange them and complete adorable cartoon pictures, such as little animals, vehicles, and fairy-tale characters. The game features vibrant colors and lively 3D models that will immediately capture a child's attention. Not only does it provide hours of fun, but it also helps develop a child's logical thinking, spatial awareness, and problem-solving skills.

title: About a Frog
description: Jump into the world of About a Frog, a fun and free online game where you play as a brave little frog. Explore colorful levels, dodge obstacles, and enjoy the adventure on your phone or computer. It’s a light and exciting challenge for players who love quick reflexes and cute characters.

title: Survival in Area 51
description: You will play as the character Stas, who works in Area 51. One day, Stas was given a strange task, to find acid and pour it into an unusual device. Then something terrible happened... In Area 51, an explosion occurred underground, and zombies appeared. They began to attack scientists and guards. Your task is to destroy zombies, mercenaries and find a way out of this terrible underground place. The game offers shooting, simple puzzles, a plot, many locations and a final battle.

title: TOP HOG
description: Welcome to the forest adventure! A drowsy bear just wants to rest, but a playful group of hedgehogs  has decided to throw a party close by. Your task? Grab a hockey stick and send those troublemakers soaring through the air! Build your strength, collect bonuses to enhance your skills, and face the exciting challenges in each level. Who will rise as the winter forest champion? Become a true bear hockey expert! Simple to play, fun, and packed with thrilling airborne action! Give it a try now!

title: Airport Simulator Plane Tycoon
description: Want a fun airport management experience in the Airport Simulator: Plane Tycoon? You're in charge of your bustling airport! Always dreamed of building and running your international airport? Now's your chance in this exciting and highly addictive management game! You will build your airport kingdom from scratch.

title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
description: Tsunami Brainrots Online is a fast-paced survival experience inspired by meme culture and chaotic movement gameplay. Players must escape a massive tsunami wave while exploring dangerous areas, collecting valuable brainrot characters, and returning safely before time runs out. The game offers an online single-player mode where you can interact with others through chat, as well as a local 2 player option for shared-screen action.

title: Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon
description: Welcome to Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon! Do you dream of owning your own movie theater empire? Now's your chance! In this super fun idle simulation management game, you'll start with a small screening room! Build your own cinema empire! As a theater owner, you need to manage every aspect of the theater. Unlock the theater's facilities, ticket booths, movie halls, dining areas, and more. Hiring employees to help you get more bang for your buck.

title: HeroBall Adventures 2
description: It’s time to embark on a brand new adventure in this great game, this time in a spherical theme! Heroball Adventures 2 is finally here! It’s a fun game where heroball has to save his friends who were abducted by a strange machine on an otherwise calm day. Control the character, jump over obstacles and try to save all of your friends. Be sure to try to get to the end of each level. Collect points and unlock new abilities!

title: Accurate 2D
Pixel Number - DIY Coloring
description: Unleash your creativity with Pixel Number – DIY Coloring! Choose from a huge collection of pixel art images – from cute animals to cool patterns – and bring them to life with color.

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Match-3: Dream Room
description: Assemble the dream room and show your friends how to transform the space with clever combos! Join Match-3: Dream Room and create your dream room by solving puzzles and enjoying the exciting process of furnishing!

title: Tricky Castle
description: The knight finds himself in a medieval castle full of tricky traps and puzzles. His goal is to escape by overcoming dangerous levels. Help the hero get out of this treacherous place and test your skills in our thrilling platformer!

title: Deep in the Lab - Chapter 1
description: Deep in the Lab is 2D '90 style survival horror game, with old style pre-rendered backgrounds, puzzles to solve, keys to collect, monster to avoid or defeat (your choice), poor resources, jumpscares, limited saves, FMV and a five floors lab to explore.

title: Arrow Slide Puzzle
description:
Arrow Slide Puzzle — Logic Puzzle Game
Arrow Slide Puzzle is a clean and engaging logic puzzle game where you slide arrows across the board to clear the field and reveal a hidden picture. Simple rules turn into deep challenges that test your logic, planning, and spatial thinking. Perfect for fans of arrow puzzles, sliding logic games, and relaxing brain teasers.

? Download now and start solving today!

title: My Cat Restaurant
description: Welcome to My Cat Restaurant, a casual kids cooking simulator game that you can play for free. Act as a chef and restaurant manager. Take orders, cook food, serve customers, and collect money. Plan your moves and workload in advance, and figure out an efficient routine.

title: Otu
description:
In OTU, you control a nimble triangle bound to a circular orbit. Your mission is simple: stay alive as long as possible. But the universe is against you! Spheres close in from the void, shrinking bars attempt to crush you, and lethal rotating lasers force you to keep moving.

Think you’ve mastered the rhythm? Every 10 seconds, the game throws a Random Debuff at you. From screen-shaking earthquakes and inverted controls to pixelated vision and orbit shifts—no two runs are ever the same!

title: Happy Bubbles
description: Boom! Hear that pop? The bubbles are calling! This classic bubble shooter blends quick reflexes with clever strategy. Spin the Lucky Wheel for extra rewards, claim weekly bonus and dive into a bright, cute world that never runs out of fun.

title: Small Wardrobe
description: Small Wardrobe is a casual game designed specifically for cotton dolls. Collect and create beautiful and cute dresses for your cotton dolls, and experience heartwarming and fun stories. The game offers a variety of adorable doll clothes, shoes, and accessories. Let's happily organize and tidy up the doll's wardrobe together!

title: Vortex io
description:
Play Vortex.io for free! Swallow everything in your path and become the biggest vortex in this fast-paced io game.

Vortex.io is a competitive .io game where you control a growing vortex that can swallow objects, vehicles, and even other players. As you absorb more items, your size increases, making you more powerful in the arena. The game features smooth controls and intense gameplay, requiring quick reflexes and smart movement to survive and dominate your rivals in real time.

title: Flight Sim Air Traffic control
description: Flight Sim is a game where you have to guide aircraft to their landing zones, keep the skies safe to complete the levels to get high score.

title: Ragdoll Bob Puzzle
description: Help Bob reach his goal in Ragdoll Bob Puzzle, a quirky and fun 2D puzzle game that challenges your brain and creativity! Bob is a floppy ragdoll who needs your help to get to the endpoint while collecting as many stars as possible along the way. But here’s the twist—you can’t control Bob directly. Instead, you must guide his path by placing a limited number of blocks and objects in the right spots to create a safe and clever route.

title: Eat And Grow Fish
description: Welcome to Eat and Grow Fish, where survival is all about eating or being eaten! Start as a tiny fish and munch your way to the top of the food chain. Explore the levels in Story Mode, or challenge your friends in Duel Mode for two-player fun. Easy to play, fun to master! Are you ready to rule the sea?

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. With simple gameplay and increasing challenges, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves casual puzzles and brain workouts. Your goal is to help the capybara solve various puzzle challenges. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

title: Daily Match
description: Connect tiles with a great number of pictures in pairs within the limited time. As you crush all the tiles on the board, you can win the level! Become a tile master level by level! Play faster and faster to train your brain and exercise the link technology!

title: Arcade GP
description: ARCADE GP is a retro-style top-down Formula 1 racing game with strategic tire management and pit stop mechanics. Race against AI opponents, manage tire wear, and make tactical decisions to claim victory!

title: Boat Mania
description: Play Boat Racing Mania free online and hit the waves in a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Race rival captains, collect upgrades, and master tight turns in a skill-based challenge that feels like a fast reflex brain game. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for nonstop water racing action anytime.

title: From Nerds to Beauties
description: Two girlfriends, the Little Mermaid and Arlene, embark on a world of stylish transformation. Their appearance, full of flaws, requires magical intervention. In the first stage of the game, the girls go through a series of fun cosmetic procedures that give them glowing skin and luxurious hair. At the second stage, you will have to become a stylist, choosing hairstyles, fashionable clothes and accessories. Each of your actions brings the heroines closer to their dream of becoming real beauties!

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: Idle Baseball Tycoon
description: Play Idle Baseball Tycoon free online and step into a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Build your dream team, upgrade stadiums, recruit players, and grow profits in a smart manager sim that blends idle strategy with brain game decision-making. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is fully mobile-friendly, working perfectly on desktop and mobile. It’s a free online game made for quick breaks and long-term domination.

title: Popping Sushi
description:
Drop adorable sushi pieces into the field and watch them merge!
When two identical pieces touch, they combine into a bigger, tastier creation.
Aim for the ultimate sushi roll and claim the top spot on the global leaderboard!

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: I Am Security
description: Have you ever wanted to be a hardened security officer and be on the front lines of maintaining order? In I Am Security, an ultra-realistic role-playing simulator, you play the role of a professional security guard. You decide whether or not to allow them to enter. Some guests may try to sneak in with prohibited items and find these hidden items. Performs tasks in a variety of scenarios to identify suspicious persons.

title: Hidden Easter Egg Hunt
description: Dive into the fun world of Hidden Easter Egg Hunt, a fun and relaxing hidden object game for players of all ages! Explore colorful spring landscapes filled with blooming flowers, green fields, and playful bunnies as you search for hidden Easter eggs scattered around the game board. With charming graphics and a festive feel, this game is perfect for getting into the Easter spirit. Test your observation skills, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy the joyful hunt!

title: Match Collection
description: Collect 3 of the same items from the shelf to erase them. When a shelf is empty, the shelf above it falls down. You can have up to 7 items, and when your hand is full, the game is over. When all items are erased, the stage is cleared.

title: Vikings: An Archer's Journey
description: Vikings: An Archer’s Journey blends the fast-paced action of a shoot ’em up with the adrenaline rush of an infinite runner, all presented in a striking minimalist art style. Play as Nott, a fearless Valkyrie archer, on a quest to save her wolf, Oder, from the Underworld. Use intuitive controls, collect powerful upgrades, and team up with Viking heroes to face off against mythical Nordic creatures in this thrilling adventure.

title: Squid Game Original
description:
n this game you will find the fun of all the games. We have collected the best and combined them into one whole. You will have to play all the popular games from the "Squid Game". However, remember: there should only be one winner left in the end.

All games are carefully recreated based on the original games. You will fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of each of them, enjoying all the game modes.

title: Butterfly Triple
description:
Butterfly Tripple is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you merge cute butterflies!
Place the shapes on the board so that three or more butterflies of the same color touch each other. When they connect, they’re released and gracefully fly away. Vivid graphics, smooth animations, and a cozy atmosphere make the game a true pleasure to play.

title: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D
description: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D is an exciting and simple scooter game where you ride through challenging tracks filled with obstacles. Your main goal is to reach the finish line without crashing. As you play, you’ll need to dodge barriers, keep your balance, and react fast. You can collect coins along the way to unlock new scooters with cool designs. With smooth controls and many levels to explore, the game offers fun, speed, and tricks for anyone who loves action on two wheels.

title: Cosmic Dash
description: Jump into Cosmic Dash – an endless space runner full of speed and challenges! Dodge debris, break through asteroids, and gather tokens as you race across the solar system. Use boosts, shrinks, and jumps to chase high scores and experience thrilling interplanetary action!

title: Color Conquest: Territory War
description:
Command one of 4 unique factions in this intense RTS war! Capture territories to expand your army and destroy enemy bases.

Factions:

Grey: High HP (Tank), slow production.

Green: Fast spawn (Swarm), low HP.

Blue & Yellow: Balanced fighters.

Capture neutral zones to increase your unit capacity. Can you dominate the map?

title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West number bubble shooter! Shoot and match numbers to merge them into higher values, creating bigger combos and clearing the board. Plan your shots, stack smart, and ride through dusty levels full of challenge and fun!

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Math Obby
description: Combine your math skills with parkour prowess in Math Obby, an engaging Roblox experience that challenges players with arithmetic problems amidst obstacle courses. Navigate through stages that test both your agility and your knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Earn badges as you progress and showcase your mastery in this educational adventure.

title: The Stone Miner
description: Become the ultimate mining tycoon in The Stone Miner! Drive your powerful mining machine through various fantasy terrains. Crush, collect and smash stones like never before! Steer your mine cart through rocks of different colors and materials and enjoy the exhilarating experience of stone mining. Sell collected stones for gold, and unlock new areas full of rare materials and surprises! Upgrade your vehicle to mine faster and deeper, turning your gear into a true beast!

title: Parkour Block 7
description:
Skill game, classic mode from your favorite games right in the browser on your computer and phone!
More levels and more mechanics await for you

title: Draw To Kill
description: Draw To Kill is a free online drawing puzzle game for boys played on PuzzleGame. First, you need to observe the distribution of the enemy and draw the route in advance. Then your character will assassinate the enemy according to your route, and you can succeed after killing all the enemies. Every operation must be done in one go. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable. Enjoy Draw To Kill!

title: Family Idle Farm: Build & Harvest
description: Play Family Idle Farm: Build & Harvest free online and grow your dream farm in a cozy browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Plant crops, raise animals, and upgrade your land in a relaxing strategy experience that feels like a light brain game of smart planning. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game perfect for quick breaks or laid-back farming anytime.

title: Shoot And Drive
description:
Radiation is spreading all over the world. People are going crazy, a tough battle for life continues.
After falling into the trap of bandits along with your crewmates, you’ll have to fight to the end. And your best ‘friends’ — a rusty gun and a car that’s about to stall — will come to your aid.

title: Find Goods
description: Find and tap on goods! Clear the stage when you find all the goods. Game over when time runs out. You can scroll and zoom the map. Be careful, as tapping items other than those specified will reduce the time limit.

title: Cut In Half
description:
Cut obstacles in the way with knives or characters.
If you touch a red block or fall into a valley, it's a game over.
Collect the goods as much as you cut the obstacles to unlock new characters!

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: Jewel Miner Quest
description: The dazzling world of gems awaits! Participate in thrilling events within limited moves or time. Solve captivating puzzles, complete fun tasks, and enjoy daily bonuses. Discover many terrific surprises with every move and see how far you can go.

title: Moto Attack Bike Racing
description: Moto Attack - Bike Racing is a fun bike racing simulator that takes speed and action to the next level. Drive your motorcycle and race against opponents. You can use weapons to attack them. Ride your bike through challenging tracks, and avoid obstacles like people crossing the street, cabs, boxes, etc.

title: Ellie Chinese New Year Celebration
description: Celebrate the beauty and traditions of the Chinese New Year with Ellie in this fun and engaging game! Known as the Lunar New Year, this festival is marked by vibrant decorations, delicious food, and exciting cultural customs. Join Ellie as she prepares for the celebration by dressing up in stunning traditional outfits, decorating her space, and participating in festive activities.

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Freecell Solitaire
description:
Put your mind to the test with FreeCell, one of the most beloved solitaire card games of all time!

Move cards between columns, use the free cells cleverly, and organize suits in ascending order to win.

Elegant graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls make every game a relaxing and satisfying experience.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or a curious beginner, FreeCell will win you over with its perfect mix of simplicity and strategy.

title: Idle Pizza Business
description: Grow your own pizza empire by hiring staff, expanding your shop, and earning more money in this 3D idle business simulator!

title: Witch & Fairy BFF
description: Two unusual girlfriends - a Fairy and a Witch - study together, although they are so different. Fairy, with her delicate pink outfits and impeccable sense of style, is always ready to offer fashion tips and create vivid images. Her girlfriend-Witch, who prefers a Gothic style, chooses mysterious and gloomy outfits. Players will be able to help both heroines choose outfits for various events. Join magical friends in their exciting fashion adventure where style and magic go hand in hand!

title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
description: Immerse yourself in Flag Jam, a unique blend of puzzle-solving, flags collecting, and visual ASMR effects! Tap to match banner pieces, watch them glide smoothly into place, and clear the board as you complete each flag. With easy-to-learn mechanics and stunning visual effects, Flag Jam is the perfect game to help you unwind.

title: Kingdom Puzzles
description: Kingdom Puzzle is a relaxing brain game where you see a grid with different colored regions. Your goal is to place one king in each region while following the rules. Each region can have only one king, and kings cannot be in the same row or column. They also cannot be next to each other, meaning the nearest tiles must be empty. To win the level, you must place all kings correctly. Placing a king in the wrong spot reduces your points.

title: Save the crop
description: Save the Crop is an exciting arcade game where you control a tractor to rescue crops from fire! ?? Quickly cut and collect crops before they burn, then stack and sell them to earn money. Use your earnings to upgrade your tractor, buy storage houses, and explore new fields. Navigate using joystick controls and master the art of saving and farming in this fast-paced, action-packed game!

title: Grill It All
description: Grill it all is a cooking-themed match-3 puzzle game. Play as a grill expert, matching identical skewers to complete orders. Strategically arrange ingredients like fish, leeks, and meatballs on grills. Test your observation and speed while using upgrade tools for strategic depth!

title: World Flags Trivia
description: Challenge your geography skills in World Flags Trivia! Identify the nation for each flag from three choices across 194 questions. Perfect your skills as you progress through increasingly tricky questions. Can you score a perfect game and become a true flag expert? Play now and find out!

title: Puzzle Blocks
description:
Race against time in tense speed battles, employ tactical thinking in rescue missions, and unwind by creating massive structures in free-play mode. Hone your skills assembling perfect puzzles or challenge the ever-accelerating chaos.

Puzzle Blocks is more than a game; it's a curated collection of perfectly crafted puzzles for any mood. The world of puzzles awaits its hero. Can you conquer every challenge?

title: Collect Em All
description:
Collect Em All! Is a puzzle game where you connect all the adjacent same colored blocks. Make long chains of colors to create beautiful sounds and unlock explosive power-ups!

Connect the dots to crush them. You can make a limited number of moves, and you cannot go back on yourself, so make sure to plan your path. Create the longest chains for the biggest reward!

 Come back every day to unlock new daily bonuses !

title: Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts
description:
Challenging yet relaxing Nuts & Bolts sort puzzle with a unique twist!

Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts is a fun and addictive stack sort puzzle game with a unique twist! Strategically sort and match three same color nuts based on box color in this jam puzzles. Every level offers an exciting challenge in this addictive sort colors puzzle game. Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: BMG: CrashDay 2025
description: The game "BMG: CrashDay 2025" is an arcade racing simulator that combines elements of action and realism. Players can choose from a variety of cars, each with its own unique characteristics and appearance. The game has various tracks, each with its own features, such as difficult turns, steep climbs and descents, as well as various obstacles.

title: Deadflip Frenzy
description:
Deadflip Frenzy is a wild stunt-flipping action game where chaos meets style! Launch your character into the air, pull off insane flips, twists, and bone-crunching landings — all in the name of fun (and maybe a little destruction).

Bounce off trampolines, launch from cannons, smash through obstacles, and aim for the most outrageous combos. The more insane your flip, the higher your score. But beware — one bad landing and it’s ragdoll mayhem!

title: Fish Shooting Fish Hunter
description: Want to begin a fun and relaxing fishing adventure? In Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter, you’ll become a fishing master. Use your skills and quick reflexes to catch various fish while enjoying a laid-back casual experience!

title: Quiz 10 Seconds Math
description: Quiz 10 Seconds Math is a fun, fast-paced educational game that challenges your mental math skills! Race against the clock to solve addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems—each level gets harder as you progress. With only 10 seconds per question, every decision counts. Track your best score, compete with yourself, and boost your brainpower anytime, anywhere. Perfect for students, teachers, and math lovers who want to learn while playing! , no distractions

title: Fix The Hoof
description: Fix The Hoof is a soothing simulation game where you take on the role of a hoof care specialist, restoring and beautifying the hooves of animals like horses, cows, and goats. Enjoy deeply satisfying ASMR moments as you clean, polish, and paint hooves in this engaging 3D experience. Earn money from your services to upgrade your farm and expand your collection of animals to care for.

title: Dolphin Couple Underwater Dress Up
description: In Dolphin Couple Underwater Dress Up, you get to explore a vibrant underwater world where two playful dolphins are ready to get glammed up! This charming dress-up game lets you choose outfits, accessories, and fun props to create a stylish underwater look for both dolphins.

title: Car Simulator 3d & Car game 3d
description: In this school car parking simulator, you get to drive in the different car driving arenas skillfully with the various parking method and driving skills. Your love for 3d parking games will help you to play all levels and perform great driving in this offline parking game.

title: Shop Sorting 2
description:
Love organizing and keeping things tidy? Then Shop Sorting 2 is the perfect game for you! Step into a satisfying sorting puzzle where you arrange and categorize products in a well-stocked store.
In Shop Sorting 2, the challenge shifts from organizing specialty goods to managing the variety and chaos of a busy supermarket. Test your skills as you handle groceries, household items, and more. Enjoy rewarding match and sort gameplay, unlock new products, and upgrade your store layout.

title: Fruit Survivor
description: Fruit Survivor is a cool and exciting 3D cartoon survival arcade game. You play as a gardener who is attacked by fruit monsters. You have to fight your way out and destroy them with different weapons. I recommend choosing the blender and maxing it out first. It can deal with many strong enemies effectively. You can also experiment with different weapon combinations to challenge yourself with harder levels. Enjoy hunting fruit monsters!

title: Snake 2048.io
description: Cubes are all around the arena and it is time to collect these cubes and merge them to have a longer 2048 cube snake! A great 2048 game begins with cube snakes and cubes in a huge arena. You will start with a low number of snakes, collect lower numbered cubes around the map, and try to make your snake bigger by combining numbers. Collect power-ups and give your snake more advantages.

title: Farm Match Seasons 2
description: Farm Match Seasons 2 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the legendary Garden Tales, Forest Match and Solitaire Farm Seasons. Your friend Poppy needs your help to look after the most beautiful farm in the village. Together you will harvest strawberries, collect flowers and protect butterflies on their farm fields. What is important that you keep the farm free from weeds! The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Pixel Fun Color By Number
description: Pixel Fun - Color By Number is a fun coloring game that lets you bring pixel art to life. With casual number-based instructions, you’ll fill in each pixel square to reveal stunning artwork.Each image is divided into tiny pixels. Each is assigned a number that corresponds to a color. For example, click on the city scene to fill in color and light up the street.

title: Mr Bounce
description: Challenge yourself with Mr Bounce, the brain-boosting puzzle game that will test your thinking skills and reflexes. Each level is a new puzzle demanding strategic planning and precise execution. Mr Bounce is more than just a game; it's a mental workout that improves your cognitive abilities.

title: Vex X3M 2
description:
Building on the classic Vex experience, VEX X3M2 introduces intense levels packed with new hazards and mechanics. New features like kite gliding let you soar over gaps, while teleportation portals help you navigate tricky sections. Floating platforms and shifting obstacles keep you on your toes, making every race an unpredictable thrill ride.
Earn stars to unlock high-performance bike skins and conquer each track in easy and hard mode to prove yourself as the ultimate Vex champion!

title: Pool Duel
description: Keep your focus sharp as the clock ticks down, knowing that timing and precision will lead you to victory. Master your aim and cue control, because flawless execution and smart strategy separate true champions from the rest in every challenging match.

title: Cube Speed Dash
description: Jump, dash, and survive in Cube Speed Dash, a high-speed arcade challenge where every second counts! Master lightning-fast reflexes as you guide a nimble cube through treacherous obstacle courses filled with spikes, traps, and deadly pitfalls. One wrong move—and it’s game over!

title: Lovie Chic's Coachella Festival
description: Step into the vibrant world of Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival, the ultimate festival dress-up game! Style your character with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to shine at the iconic Coachella Festival. With simple controls and endless creativity, Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: Mushroom Fever Match 3
description:
Immerse yourself in the magical forest with Mushroom Fever - Match 3! Bright and cheerful mushrooms replace traditional crystals, adding a fresh twist to the classic match-3 genre. This game will bring you hours of thrilling fun and bursts of excitement!

Match groups of three or more mushrooms, complete engaging tasks, and unlock new levels! Each level brings unique puzzles and fresh challenges. The more matches you make, the more points and bonuses you’ll earn!

title: Makeup Fruits
description: In Makeup Fruits, give your favorite fruits a stunning makeover! Apply makeup, add accessories, and create fabulous fruit beauty icons. Choose from a variety of makeup options, including powder, lipstick, and eyelashes. Take a "selfie" of your creation and share it with friends! Earn gems to unlock even more fun items and keep the transformation going!

title: Farm Block
description: Farm Block is an engaging farm-themed puzzle game where players slide adorable animal blocks to free them from the farm. Test your strategic thinking and enjoy the charming countryside setting! With its mix of puzzle-solving and elimination mechanics, Farm Block offers a fun and rewarding challenge for all ages.

title: Smoke Trail
description:
Drift and earn in this fast-paced 2D endless drifting game!
Master the art of controlled slides across an ever-changing track. Rack up cash by chaining stylish drifts and maintaining momentum—then use your earnings to unlock a growing collection of iconic drift cars, each with its own unique stats and feel. But it’s not just about the money—complete challenges to test your skill, and unlock a special car.

Easy to pick up, hard to master—how far can you go before you crash?

title: Spa empire
description:
? BUILD YOUR DREAM SPA EMPIRE

Have you ever dreamed of running the ultimate spa, offering everything from soothing massages to exciting makeovers? Step into My Spa Empire, the idle arcade game where you dye hair, create stunning hair color makeovers and manage a bustling spa filled with exciting treatments. Design, upgrade, and expand your spa into the ultimate relaxation haven for your guests.

title: Home Island
description:
Looking for a family adventure game? Try our Home Island: Family Pin free puzzle games about village life in paradise island! Pull the pin to solve the puzzle, follow the story and enjoy adventures on the island.
On the adventure for discovering the new island, a family cruise ship plane had to face an accident because of the bad weather. The father has gone missing, but the mother and their daughter luckily survived and got to a strange island.

title: Golf Mini
description: Golf Mini is a fun and addictive game in which your goal is to get the ball to the hole in the minimum number of strokes. Complete levels, each of which is a unique golf course with various obstacles and traps.

title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
description: Bubble Shooter Free 3 is back with a long-awaited 3rd sequel to one of the most popular bubble shooter games there is! This bubble shooter embraces endless gameplay that is designed for players to enjoy hours and hours of fun without time pressure. It boasts the ‘Bubble Swap’ feature which lets you swap the current bubble in your shooter with the incoming one as well as the BOMB which creates huge explosions popping 15 bubbles at once! Now the players can play even more strategically!

title: Elementz
description: ElementZ is a Match-3 game similar to Bejeweled or Candy Crush. Its particularity lies in giving each color its elemental power, allowing you to trigger different powers of fire (red), water (blue), earth (brown), plants (green), and electricity (yellow).

title: Water Dig Rescue
description: Dive into the captivating world of "Water Dig Rescue," a physics-based puzzle game where strategy and water manipulation go hand-in-hand. Players carve their way through sand to guide streams of water, aiming to fill a waiting truck at each level's end. With a touch of ingenuity and the laws of physics, can you solve the puzzles and achieve a triumphant splash?

title: Traffic Light Simulator 3D
description:
"Traffic-Light simulator" is an immersive simulation game where players take on the role of a traffic controller tasked with managing the flow of vehicles through a bustling city intersection. Set against the backdrop of a dynamic urban landscape, players must strategically operate a traffic light to prevent congestion, accidents, and ensure smooth traffic flow.
With each passing level, the intensity and complexity of traffic increase, testing the player's decision-making skills and reflexes.

title: Dino Hide N Shoot
description: Do you want to begin a fun dinosaur-themed shooting game in Dino Hide N Shoot? Play a brave gunman on an exciting adventure! In this game, you will constantly run to avoid the attack of dinosaurs.And pick up the bullets, accumulate enough firepower. Pay attention to using the box as cover,seize the moment to shoot at the dinosaur! The gameplay is simple yet challenging.

title: Heritage Mahjong Classic
description: Immerse yourself in a timeless Mahjong experience with Heritage Mahjong Classic. Featuring a single elegant layout, three unique tile skins, a time bonus for quick matches, and a competitive leaderboard, this game offers a simple yet captivating challenge. Perfect for players of all levels, enjoy a relaxing atmosphere as you match tiles, earn bonuses, and climb the ranks. Are you ready to test your skills and embrace the charm of classic Mahjong? Start your journey today!

title: Merge Hospital
description:
Play as Doctor Player in Merge Hospital and discover the many secrets of your staff members, and what is happening in and around the Hospital. In Merge Hospital by Operate Now you will merge and build, meet and love many skilled surgeons, doctors and other interesting characters. You will learn more about their stories and how they got into the hospital.

As Dr. Player you must:
MERGE medical items, pies and much more!
DISCOVER the story of a medical drama like in your favorite TV shows.

title: Find The Cat - Cat Search
description: Discover the exciting world of finding hidden cats in this original puzzle game! Look for cats on black and white backgrounds by tapping on them to complete levels. With each stage, you will unlock new places and receive unique challenges that will test your attentiveness and observation skills.

title: Meow Slide
description: Meow Slide is a brain training puzzle, entertain your brain for minutes or hours with endless challenges. The Meow Slide puzzle is simple: slide blocks left or right to create and clear full lines.

title: Sorting Xmas Balls
description:
Sorting Xmas Balls is a cozy winter puzzle game where you sort colorful Christmas ornaments into their correct tubes. Move the balls, group matching colors together, and enjoy calm, festive gameplay.

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging with more tubes and more colors to organize. Bright graphics and a cheerful holiday theme make every level relaxing and satisfying to complete.

title: Boolu Bask
description: Dunk Ball game is an exciting sports-based game that brings the thrills of basketball right to your device. The focus of the game is on scoring points by aiming each ball into the moving basket. Show off your agility, precision, and timing as you handle each ball with finesse and drop them into the basket for maximum points.

title: Fish rain 2
description:
"Cast and pull!" is the motto of this fishing game. Everything is real here: the sounds in the locations, and the online chat. Share your legendary trophies with other players, show off your catch, and name the weight and type of fish.

 Try to catch a pike or a catfish, a perch or a minnow, or maybe a carp or a sturgeon?

 Fish in different locations: on a rocky shore or on the Pripyat River. Use a variety of baits, from worms to live bait and leeches.

title: Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl, where you can live out your fashion dreams and become a master of anime dress-up!

title: Warfront
description: Warfront is a combat simulator for pro gamers inspired by CS, Standoff, and Valorant. Dive into the world of competitive FPS, testing your shooting and tactical skills across various levels. Assemble teams, improve your abilities, and upgrade your character to dominate in shooter eSports. Experience the thrill of classic CS and Valorant-style gameplay. Ready to become a counter master and a standoff legend? Prove it in Warfront!

title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to Farm Animal Sort Puzzle, a fun and relaxing casual puzzle game set on a lively farm. Your mission is simple but addictive: match the appropriate animal or vegetable to the customer's needs. Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

title: Cat Rescue
description: Protect the cat from dragon invasions through strategic sort puzzle combat. As enemies display colored patterns, your cannon must sort puzzle sequences to match their hues. Click the correctly colored cannon to obliterate matching dragon sections. Each precise cannon shot slows their advance toward the cat! Repeat until dragon threats vanish, but remember: rescue missions demand speed and sort puzzle accuracy!

title: Mr Bullet: Stealth Ninja Killstreak
description: Stealth action about a special agent! Third-person shooter about secret missions. Shootouts with stickmen. Physical destruction! Battles with dangerous Bosses. Tanks, Helicopters, Mutants! Road chases with destructible cars and much more!

title: Sisyphus Simulator
description: An addictive and challenging hyper-casual 3D game. Push the rock up the hill cleverly so that it won't fall down. Reach the top of the hill and collect the honor star to complete the challenge and raise your name on the Honor Board.

title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
description: This is a first-person psychological horror game where you work night shifts in a small street kiosk. What seems like a normal job quickly turns into a nightmare: customers grow increasingly strange, and reality itself begins to warp. Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.

title: Alien Chase - Swing and Fly
description: Alien Chase - Swing and Fly is the wildest swinging game in town! Play as a superhero on vacation, caught in the middle of an alien invasion. With nothing but your grappling skills, swing between towering skyscrapers and outrun the relentless alien swarm. It’s fast, it’s frantic, and it’s an endless escape—how far can you swing?

title: Popping Candies
description: Match and crush candies to achieve goals in this addictive puzzle game! Swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more and clear the board. Create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs to enhance your progress. Overcome obstacles like chocolate and blockers while completing each level's unique objectives. Be mindful of your limited moves! Use boosters for extra assistance and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages.

title: HexaMatch
description:
HexaMatch – The Ultimate Number Puzzle!
Swipe and sort tiles into the empty slot to solve addictive hexa puzzles. With progressive difficulty, unique gameplay, and a fresh twist on classic number games, HexaMatch is perfect for all ages. Train your brain, relax your mind, and enjoy endless fun with this simple yet challenging merge hexa puzzle!

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: Math Wall Simulator
description: Combine brainpower and action in this math-based Roblox adventure! Solve equations to break through walls, collect coins, and unlock new challenges. Progress through 20 classes of increasing difficulty, from basic arithmetic to extreme math puzzles

title: Construction Set - 3D Builder
description:
Dive into the fascinating world of 3D constructors and puzzles, where each block is a new step towards creativity and development.
This game invites players to assemble amazing buildings, monuments and characters using more than 200 different bricks.
From simple sets to complex models, each level presents a new challenge and develops attention, logic and spatial thinking.

title: Minicraft Winterblock
description: Winter has arrived, and everything is covered in snow. In the snow-covered forest, you must be very careful to survive. You need to find two chests and collect all the snowballs. But be cautious, there are monsters everywhere waiting to eat you. You must defeat the monsters and reach the hidden portal at the end of the level. You must leave the house safely and pass through the portal.

title: Pops Quest
description: In this story-based platformer, you'll step into the shoes of a heroic protagonist driven by an undying love for their child. Experience the perfect fusion of action and platforming as Pop's Quest takes you on a high-octane adventure. With its fast-paced gameplay levels designed, you'll be engrossed in a world that demands agility, strategy, and quick reflexes. As you progress, you'll be emotionally invested and driven to save your child from danger.

title: Snake 2048
description: Start as a small cube in this thrilling online game! Eat smaller snakes, dodge stronger ones, and grow into a giant. Enjoy endless challenges, competitive leaderboards, and exciting gameplay. Play now and dominate the arena!

title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you sort colorful balls into tubes – can you solve the puzzle with fewer moves?

title: Let The Train Go
description: Unblock Metro is a fascinating puzzle game. You need to move all the vehicles in front of the metro so that the metro drives smoothly along the track. You have to be careful that the head of the vehicle is facing that way and you can't change the direction of the vehicle. There are cars,trucks, ambulances, and so on. Lovely pictures and a wide variety of cars give you a refreshing gaming experience. The intricate vehicles placed in front of the metro will dazzle you. Waiting for your challenge！

title: Black Cat Stacking POP
description: Tap tiles to clear them! When you tap a tile, any same-colored tiles next to it will also connect and clear together. Clear a bunch of tiles at once, and a toy mouse will appear to help clear even more! Clear target tiles or tiles that add moves to increase your remaining moves. The game ends when you run out of moves.

title: Building Mods For Minecraft
description: Building Mods For Minecraft is the ultimate game for those who love to build and fight. If you’re a Minecraft fan looking for a new adventure, this game takes the building mechanics of Minecraft to the next level, combining construction with action. You’ll have access to a wide range of building tools and guns.

title: Classic Mine Sweeper
description: Dive back into "Mine Sweeper Classic," the ultimate nostalgic puzzle game from the Windows XP era, perfect for strategic gameplay during any downtime. Challenge yourself with levels from beginner to expert and relive the excitement of this timeless classic.

title: Chain Cube 2048 3D Merge Game
description:
Ready to challenge yourself? Chain Cubes 2048 is an addictive merging puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merging games. Believe it or not, it's much
harder to put together 2048 cubes than it is to throw away the numbers. If you fail to merge the cube number blocks, they will bounce off each other!  Keep playing and eventually complete 2248 number puzzles!

title: Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon
description: Get spooky and stylish in Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon, where gothic meets glam in a 3-level makeover game. Treat Wednesday to a facial, apply stunning dark-themed makeup, and finish off with iconic dress-up fashion in her unique style. From skincare to eyeliner, you control every detail of her transformation. Whether you’re a fan of the Addams aesthetic or just love alternative beauty, this salon experience offers a complete glow-up from head to toe.

title: Super Kid Adventure
description: Hi there! It sounds like you're interested in playing Super Kid Adventure, an online game similar to Super Mario. To play, you'll need to jump on platforms, avoid obstacles and spikes, and defeat enemies. Don't forget to collect stars along the way! The game has 25 levels for you to explore, so there's plenty of adventure to be had.

title: Sailor Chic vs Pirate Charm
description: Welcome to the trendy sea adventure! Two charming heroines are waiting for you in game: the humble little mermaid Amelie and the brave pirate princess Jacqueline. Amelie is the epitome of maritime glamour. Her style is white dresses, gold jewelry and wind in her hair. Jacqueline is the real pirate queen. She wears leather jackets, spectacular corsets and accessories with pirate symbols. Who will win in this fashionable battle - a sophisticated beauty or a daring sea robber? The choice is yours!

title: Superhero Transform Change Race
description: Are you ready to be a superhero and have a racing adventure? In Superhero Transform - Change Race,you should run and transform! In the challenging track, you will incarnate different superheroes.  Use their special abilities to avoid obstacles and surpass opponents. Each transformation has a unique skill set. For example, you can become Spider-Man and climb rock. Turn into a shark and swim quickly to the next challenge; Turn into the Flash and sprint to the finish line, etc.

title: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator
description: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator is a 3D strategy battle game where planning is the key to victory. Build your army of Swordsmen, Spearmen, and Archers, analyze enemy formations, and lead your ninja forces to triumph across challenging levels.

title: Race Clicker
description: Race Clicker is an action-packed idle clicker racing game that'll pump up your adrenaline. Customize, upgrade, and speed your way to victory. Each click pushes your limits, every upgrade unveils new possibilities, and each race dares you to click faster. Leave rivals in the dust and satisfy your need for speed with endless excitement. Start your engines and hit the track now!

title: Striped Fruit - Watermelon Land
description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Striped Fruit that full of strategy and fun. Here, you'll become a watermelon maker extraordinaire, mastering the art of fruit merge to create the juiciest combinations on the board. As a merge master, you'll tap, drop, and combine fruits in a strategic dance.

The challenge? To reach your way to the top, the first step is to merge 2 melons to create a watermelon - the King of Fruits. Can you merge 2 watermelons to smash them out? Let's check it out!

title: Clownfish Pin Out
description: Clownfish Pin Out is an interesting and cute puzzle game, you need to help one little fish escape from a dangerous place. Tap the pin to make the waterfall to the fish and avoid the lava. Think before you move, or you will lose. Come on!
